raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-KHM-BasicEducationImprovement",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Financial Management staff may be overloaded, causing delays in processing transactions and reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit additional FM officers and consultants within three months; implement workload monitoring and task prioritization.",
      "evidence": "FM assessment identified current FM staff at Directorate General of Administration and Finance may be overloaded."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Delayed approval of the Annual Work Plan and Budget could postpone activity implementation.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a fast‑track approval workflow with clear deadlines and senior sign‑off commitments.",
      "evidence": "Risk noted that delayed approval of the AWPB may hinder timely implementation."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "School mentoring funds may not be properly monitored, leading to misallocation.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Introduce a transparent tracking system, quarterly audits, and mandatory reporting templates for mentoring expenditures.",
      "evidence": "Risk that school mentoring funding, spent at schools, may not be properly monitored."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "MoEYS procurement staff have limited knowledge of World Bank procurement rules, risking non‑compliance and delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide intensive World Bank procurement training and certify staff before procurement activities commence.",
      "evidence": "MoEYS staff’s limited knowledge and experience with World Bank Procurement Regulations could cause delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Potential corrupt practices in procurement could undermine project integrity.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Enforce strict disclosure, publish procurement plans and award summaries, and establish an independent complaint mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Governance risks, including corrupt practices in procurement, identified in procurement risk assessment."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Insufficient capacity for contract supervision may cause implementation delays.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Assign dedicated contract supervisors, provide on‑the‑job training, and set up performance monitoring dashboards.",
      "evidence": "Inadequate capacity for contract supervision and management may result in implementation delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Internal clearance delays from the procurement review committee could stall procurement.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a joint clearance task force with defined turnaround times and escalation procedures.",
      "evidence": "Possible delays in internal clearance from procurement review committee noted as a risk."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Floods, cyclones and extreme heat may damage school facilities and interrupt learning.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Construct all new buildings to climate‑resilient standards, locate them in lower‑risk zones, and develop emergency shelter plans.",
      "evidence": "Approximately 10% of schools in <2 m flood zones; 31% exposed to cyclones; extreme heat increasing school closures."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Climate‑resilient construction may not meet design specifications, leaving facilities vulnerable.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement third‑party design review and independent post‑construction inspections to verify compliance.",
      "evidence": "Designs incorporate climate‑resilient construction practices; risk of inadequate implementation implied."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "ICT equipment could fail under high temperature or humidity, disrupting e‑learning.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Procure equipment rated for tropical climates and house devices in climate‑controlled cabinets.",
      "evidence": "ICT equipment must withstand extreme temperatures and humidity; design includes climate‑controlled environments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Teachers may lack capacity to implement EGL and TaRL approaches effectively.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deliver intensive pre‑service and in‑service training, followed by continuous mentoring and performance monitoring.",
      "evidence": "Insufficient teacher capacity identified as a principal cause of poor learning outcomes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Targeted instruction pilot (TaRL) may not scale due to limited evidence on costs and impact.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct rigorous pilot evaluation, document lessons, and develop a scalable implementation guide before expansion.",
      "evidence": "Targeted instruction is being piloted in 2025; less information is available on costs, impact, and scaling requirements."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Low enrollment in early childhood education could limit primary school readiness gains.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement community outreach, parental education campaigns, and incentives for enrollment in ECE programs.",
      "evidence": "Limited readiness among children results from inadequate access to quality childcare and early childhood education."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Gender‑based violence (GBV) data gaps may hinder effective prevention and response measures.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Integrate GBV data collection into school monitoring systems and strengthen teacher training on GBV awareness.",
      "evidence": "Significant lack of comprehensive data on GBV prevalence in the education sector."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Inadequate inclusion of children with disabilities may reduce equity of learning outcomes.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Ensure all new buildings follow universal design standards and provide braille EGL materials.",
      "evidence": "Project will ensure universal design and convert EGL materials into braille for students with vision disabilities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Weak M&E capacity could produce poor quality data, compromising performance tracking.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Upgrade M&E digital tools, train staff, and conduct periodic data quality audits.",
      "evidence": "M&E capacity risks identified; digitalization of M&E processes planned to improve data quality."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Dependence on external donors (FCDO, UNICEF) for pilot funding may jeopardize scaling if funding stops.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Negotiate multi‑year funding commitments and develop a government‑financed scaling plan.",
      "evidence": "FCDO pilot and UNICEF support are key for EGL; partners’ support expected to phase out by 2027."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Early Learning Partnership grant closes in 2027, potentially leaving a financing gap for childcare components.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure additional domestic or donor financing before 2027 and align disbursements with grant timeline.",
      "evidence": "Trust Fund closing date is April 30 2027, while project runs to 2030."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Reliance on digital HRMIS and M&E tools may be disrupted by poor internet connectivity in remote areas.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide offline data entry modules and periodic synchronization when connectivity is available.",
      "evidence": "HRMIS and digital M&E will be deployed; risk of connectivity issues implied for remote districts."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Political shifts could reduce government commitment to project reforms.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Embed reforms in legally binding policies and maintain high‑level political championing through the PSC.",
      "evidence": "Project aligns with PS‑I and national priorities; political commitment is essential for sustainability."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R21",
      "description": "Construction delays may keep overcrowded classrooms in place, limiting learning improvements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Set strict construction milestones, use performance‑based payments, and monitor progress via the PMU.",
      "evidence": "Overcrowded classrooms affect learning; subcomponent 2.3 funds climate‑resilient construction to reduce class size."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R22",
      "description": "Insufficient WASH facilities could lead to health issues and absenteeism.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Ensure all new and renovated schools include gender‑separated toilets and functional water‑sanitation infrastructure.",
      "evidence": "Component 2.3 includes provision of gender‑separated toilets and WASH facilities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R23",
      "description": "Inadequate grievance redress mechanisms may allow stakeholder complaints to go unresolved, harming project reputation.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Operationalize the GRM, publicize contact channels, and track resolution timelines.",
      "evidence": "A GRM will be implemented to ensure timely responses to stakeholder feedback."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R24",
      "description": "Cost overruns in climate‑resilient construction could strain the project budget.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply rigorous cost‑control procedures, use standardized “smart‑buy” specifications, and conduct regular financial reviews.",
      "evidence": "Component 1 and 2.3 allocate funds for climate‑resilient construction; fiduciary risk includes potential cost overruns."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R25",
      "description": "Limited evidence on the effectiveness of the PLP EdTech platform at scale may reduce expected learning gains.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Pilot the platform in additional schools, collect usage analytics, and iterate based on feedback before full rollout.",
      "evidence": "PLP currently used in 1,500 schools; BEIP will expand use to all schools."
    }
  ]
}
